runner: Existing Cargo Windows integration test; isolated complete crate copies, one case at a time
environment: GitHub Actions windows-latest only. Same locked dependency graph, no local Rust, daemon, authentication or joint test. Red cases precede an unmodified control; each copy has a distinct Cargo target directory to prevent stale mutant binaries.

cases.scenario: Drop releases pending handle without requesting termination; same uncommitted launch fixture must detect the suspended live target.
cases.expectedBehavior: Control passes all 16 token/whole-launch iterations; mutant fails the exact target bounded handle wait on iteration 0.
cases.oracle: One named Rust test runs and fails with target did not terminate: whole_launch=false, iteration=0; compile/spawn/timeout errors never count as detected.
cases.sensitivityReason: Remove only cancellation termination in ResumeToken Drop in a CI temporary copy; test bytes and argv remain identical.

cases.scenario: Drop terminates the child but leaks its pending process handle; same fixture must distinguish termination from completed reference release.
cases.expectedBehavior: Control passes; mutant reaches exact process termination then fails bounded zero Job accounting on iteration 0.
cases.oracle: One named Rust test fails with uncommitted target remained: active>0, whole_launch=false, iteration=0. A handle-wait failure is the wrong red for this mutation.
cases.sensitivityReason: Leak only the Drop-owned pending handle after real termination in a CI temporary copy; unchanged test verifies the reference lifetime boundary.

exclusions: D0053 historical transient root cause is not inferred from mutation results.
Actual Desktop selected-server/GUI/TUI behavior and installation remain outside this fixture.
